date_scope_check.finding: Geography review only. Current phase bounds, traffic exceptions, uncertain onset, reopening status and >24-hour decision are retained; current map features are not evidence of historical operation.
date_scope_check.qualification: REC50-R11-003-P1: Reuters describes the 29–30 November midnight boundary; Interfax reports Russian Railways explicitly dating the Suifenhe suspension to 30 November 2021. A 9 December Logirus report, attributed to Russia’s Ministry of Industry and Trade and trade representation in China, corroborates 6 December permission for specified goods, retaining covered and temperature-controlled wagon restrictions. EastRussia independently reports the same permission date through Biang. Original Chinese notices and the first matching returning train remain unavailable, so this is a reported policy interval, not a verified operational reopening. The Logirus article contains an impossible retrospective reference to 30 December in its final paragraph; that date is not used. Container traffic and EA006 road-passenger restrictions are separate.
